valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2027 core EPS viewed at the 12-month target date. USD listing, no ADR conversion. FY2026 core EPS run-rate assumed about $3.5 from Q3 core EPS $0.91 and Q4 revenue guide near $5.25B; FY2027 EPS is my assumption, not a sourced filing figure.

bear.driver: AI optical demand digestion, margin flat

base.driver: Optical Communications keeps growing 25-40% with modest margin gains

bull.driver: Optical build-out accelerates toward the 2030 sales ambition

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS $4.30 the close implies 26.5x; the roughly $177 consensus target implies 41x or EPS about $6.3 at 28x
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $4.30 (3.8 pp)
valuation.watch_metric: Optical Communications sales growth and core operating margin
